mapper.sql: id, slug, title, description, starts_at, ends_at, venue_name, address, ST_Y(location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(location::geometry) AS longitude, image_url, source, source_url, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT slug FROM event WHERE slug = #{base} OR starts_with(slug, #{base} || '-')

INSERT INTO event (slug, title, description, starts_at, ends_at, venue_name, address, location, image_url, source, source_url, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{slug}, #{event.title}, #{event.description}, #{event.startsAt}, #{event.endsAt}, #{event.venueName}, #{event.address}, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{event.longitude}, #{event.latitude}), 4326)::geography, #{event.imageUrl}, #{event.source}, #{event.sourceUrl}, #{event.status}, #{now}, #{now}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE event SET title = #{event.title}, description = #{event.description}, starts_at = #{event.startsAt}, ends_at = #{event.endsAt}, venue_name = #{event.venueName}, address = #{event.address}, location = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{event.longitude}, #{event.latitude}), 4326)::geography, image_url = #{event.imageUrl}, source = #{event.source}, source_url = #{event.sourceUrl}, status = #{event.status}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
